properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. A field ask from Anthony's work machine (VS Code + Copilot through `--call`), 2026-10-19: "in a hub, reflow2 should allow you to view all key:value pairs for each design as sort of one design". Copilot recorded it as idea 20 in the VS Code guide (docs/using-reflow2-in-vscode-without-mcp.md, branch feat/vscode-call-door, commit 7a47bf1f0), not in the field log.

ALREADY SETTLED (searched first):
- The view is accepted and REALIZED on a hosted registry: req:a-hub-is-an-on-demand-view-over-its-members-designs-and-every-tool-runs-over-it-with-writes-landing-in-the-owning-design, dec:how-a-session-opens-a-view-over-several-designs and cap:a-hubs-address-serves-a-view-over-its-members. This session's hub uses it every day.
- Locally, only search reaches across: cap:search-design-reaches-the-designs-a-hub-tracks (planned; reads exports from disk).
- The prerequisite is OPEN: dec:idea-a-hub-on-one-machine-can-say-where-each-tracked-design-is-reached-from-the-door (idea 13, where each member's store is on this machine).
So the question is HOW the door opens the view locally, not WHETHER a hub is a view.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) THE VIEW OVER LOCAL STORES. `--call` (or `reflow2 read`) given a hub opens each member's store read-only, by the store paths idea 13 records, under the same graph_id prefixes the hosted view uses. Reads route and merge exactly as on flo2.io; writes go to one member by prefix.
(b) THE VIEW OVER COMMITTED EXPORTS. Read-only, from each member's committed export: works without the stores, but lags a member's unexported work (the known silent-lag class, fact:recurrence-an-export-watch-reads-unchanged-over-a-members-unexported-work-2026-10-05).
(c) A LOCAL SHARED SERVER PER HUB. One `--serve-shared` process for the hub that the door joins (idea 2, a call joining a running shared server), and the view is served as on flo2.io.
(d) DO NOTHING NEW. Put the hub on flo2.io, where the view exists; but his work machine cannot reach third-party MCP and may not host designs off-site.

PUSHBACK, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
- WORK POLICY. At work, MCP servers are blocked and designs may need to stay on the machine, so (d) may be ruled out by policy rather than by preference.
- IDEA 13 FIRST. (a) cannot find the stores without it; (b) can, from the pins' export paths, but lags.
- HUB GAPS ALREADY MEASURED. The hosted view still has gaps the trials found (req:through-a-hub-every-tool-can-run-on-one-named-member, phase 4). A local view would inherit them, so it is best built on phase 4's fixes.

SIZE, as a finding: (b) small to medium; (a) medium once idea 13 lands; (c) medium to large.
properties.name: OPEN — can a hub on one machine, driven through the `--call` door, open its members' local stores (or committed exports) as ONE read view, the way a hosted hub's address already does, so a requirement or issue spanning several designs reads as one design?
